- `Note` record + `NewNote` request body

- `NotesGetLogic` / `NotesPostLogic` + two new YAML routes under `rest/api/projects/` (`notes.GET.yml`, `notes.POST.yml`)

**Front-end** — `ProjectNotes.tsx`, a self-contained feature component rendered when a project is opened, exposing the `data-testid` anchors the spec expects (`note-row-*`, `note-text`, `note-form`, `note-form-text`, `note-form-submit`).
